name: org_graph_remove_level
description: Remove a level from the Org Graph's taxonomy, from effective_on (today by default). Only a level no unit has ever held, retired units included, can go; the refusal names the units. A level an HRIS provides is handed back to Espalia first. A level a live plan places a unit at stays until the plan changes or is archived. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.

structure_unit_id.description: a unit with a structure of its own, to change its unit types; the top structure by default
